scientific_integrity: The theorem relies on explicit link-dismantling inequalities and finite base reductions, not solely on finite enumeration.
scientific_limitations: Single-arc reversals of odd cyclic tournaments only; no equivariant classification or multi-arc claim. Published small-order census covers low bases; infinite chord-distance classification is the distinct contribution. External independent validation is not performed.
title: Three-phase homotopy response to one chord reversal in odd cyclic tournaments
